scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,web "npm run dev -w @wordhunt/shared" "npm run dev -w @wordhunt/server" "npm run dev -w @wordhunt/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wordhunt/shared && npm run build -w @wordhunt/server && npm run build -w @wordhunt/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @wordhunt/shared && npm run test -w @wordhunt/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @wordhunt/shared && npm run typecheck -w @wordhunt/web && npm run build -w @wordhunt/server
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @wordhunt/shared && npm run build -w @wordhunt/server
scripts.build:server:production: npm run words:ensure && npm run build:server
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @wordhunt/shared && npm run build -w @wordhunt/web
